results: 1. medication review: long-term risperidone with concomitant sertraline; myoclonus resolved completely within 24 h of withdrawing RISPERIDONE alone
2. serotonin syndrome criteria (Hunter): NOT met - no clonus, hyperreflexia, fever or autonomic instability
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Risperidone-induced myoclonus (drug-induced abdominal wall/diaphragmatic myoclonus), resolving after risperidone withdrawal

ALTERNATIVE: Sertraline–risperidone serotonin toxicity (unlikely; Hunter criteria not met)

ALTERNATIVE: Focal motor seizure presenting as abdominal jerking

ALTERNATIVE: Diaphragmatic flutter or other peripheral abdominal-wall movement disorder
dx: Risperidone-induced myoclonus (drug-induced abdominal wall/diaphragmatic myoclonus), resolving after risperidone withdrawal
